recognize_zh: 以右側小淋巴球的核為尺度，大多數紅血球比它小（小球性），且中央淡染區擴大、只剩一圈細薄的血紅素邊（低色素性），並有少數變形紅血球，符合缺鐵性貧血的血片。
features: Red cells smaller than the nucleus of the adjacent small lymphocyte (microcytosis)
Markedly enlarged central pallor exceeding one-third of the cell, with a thin hemoglobin rim (hypochromia)
Mild poikilocytosis with a few irregular, elongated and crenated forms
Small mature lymphocyte with dense chromatin and scant cytoplasm at right
Scattered platelets; no target cells or basophilic stippling prominent
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a population of microcytic, hypochromic red cells with markedly widened central pallor and thin hemoglobin rims, together with mild anisopoikilocytosis including a few elongated and irregular forms. A small mature lymphocyte serves as a size reference. Target cells and basophilic stippling are not prominent. Findings are consistent with a microcytic hypochromic anemia, most suggestive of iron deficiency; confirmation requires ferritin and iron studies.

ddx.vs: Thalassemia trait has a disproportionately low MCV with a normal/high RBC count, prominent target cells and basophilic stippling, and normal ferritin.
Usually normocytic or only mildly microcytic with less hypochromia, and ferritin is normal or increased.
Often shows a dimorphic population with Pappenheimer bodies and ring sideroblasts on marrow iron stain.
Features coarse basophilic stippling with mild microcytosis and elevated blood lead.
